prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1496; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in on the roadway in Conroe, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you describe in your own words what happened?

A: I was driving north on the two-lane road, heading toward the light. A car coming the other way drifted over into my lane. I braked and turned left, but we still met nose to nose. It wasn't a hard hit, but my airbag went off and my wrist got caught under the steering wheel.

Q: Were you going fast at the time?

A: No, I'd say maybe twenty-five miles an hour. Traffic was moving slowly and I had just slowed down for the light.

Q: Did you see the other driver before the impact?

A: Only for a second. I saw the headlights swing toward me and I tried to get out of the way.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was buckled in.

Q: Has anyone been to a doctor or hospital since the accident?

A: I went to the emergency room that same evening. They X-rayed my wrist and said it was fractured. I have a cast now and I'm seeing an orthopedic doctor next week.

Q: Are you able to work or do your normal daily activities right now?

A: Not really. I'm right-handed, so typing and driving are difficult. I've been off work for a while.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct in your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get this taken care of.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
